blockdesc-shaft-*: Carries rotation between machines. Wrap in a frame to pass it through walls and floors.
blockdesc-handcrank-*: Right click to wind. Provides a brief burst of rotation to a small network.
blockdesc-cogwheel-*: Couples two parallel shafts and reverses their direction. Place on the side of a shaft.
blockdesc-largecogwheel-*: Meshes with a small cogwheel on a perpendicular axis to step speed up or down.
blockdesc-gearbox-*: Redirects rotation between any two perpendicular shafts that meet at the corner.
blockdesc-creativemotor-*: Spins forever with no input. Creative use only.
blockdesc-coalmotor-*: Burns coal to spin a connected network. Open the firedoor side to fuel it.
blockdesc-encasedshaft-*: A shaft sleeved in wood so rotation can run through solid blocks.
blockdesc-kineticquern: An auto-quern. Drop grist on top, take flour from the side. Grinds while powered.
blockdesc-crusher-*: The driven head of a crusher pair. Mount above a Crusher Basin and feed it with a shaft.
blockdesc-crusherbasin-*: Holds the item being crushed. Put input in the top, collect output from the side or bottom.
blockdesc-belt-*: Pushes items along while powered. Right click with another belt to chain them.
blockdesc-funnel-copper-*: Pulls items from one side and ejects them out the other. Open to set a filter.
blockdesc-funnel-iron-*: A larger funnel with more filter slots than the copper version.
blockdesc-kineticsieve-*: An auto-sieve. Feed it crushed rock or dirt to recover sand, metal bits, gems and more.
blockdesc-kineticsawmill-*: An auto-sawmill. Feed logs in the top, collect planks from below. Cuts while powered.
blockdesc-kineticpress-*: An auto-press. Drop seeds or fruit on top, place a barrel below. Squeezes oil and juice while powered.
itemdesc-belt: A leather strap. Place to form a powered conveyor.
itemdesc-crusherframe: A subassembly used to build the crusher.
itemdesc-largecogwheelsection: A subassembly used to build the large cogwheel.
itemdesc-andesite-grit: Crushed andesite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-basalt-grit: Crushed basalt. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-bauxite-grit: Crushed bauxite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and clay.

itemdesc-chert-grit: Crushed chert. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-claystone-grit: Crushed claystone. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-conglomerate-grit: Crushed conglomerate. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-granite-grit: Crushed granite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-kimberlite-grit: Crushed kimberlite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve. Sometimes hides rough gems.
itemdesc-limestone-grit: Crushed limestone. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-marble-grit: Crushed marble. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-meteorite-grit: Crushed meteorite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover meteoric iron and rare metals.
itemdesc-peridotite-grit: Crushed peridotite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-phyllite-grit: Crushed phyllite. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-shale-grit: Crushed shale. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
itemdesc-slate-grit: Crushed slate. Sift in a Kinetic Sieve to recover sand and metal bits.
